featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t usually write long reviews, but this team deserves every word. I have never experienced this level of ease and peace of mind with any team that feels like family, before. Dhruv and Sourabh led an absolutely amazing team-experienced, prepared, and so deeply tuned in to every moment that mattered.

They didn’t just take photos; they made sure we lived our moments too. They would literally push my parents to step out of their Marwadi hospitality mode and actually enjoy their own celebration. They guided my CA couple to pose (which is honestly a task in itself!), and they did it with so much patience, warmth, and humour.

What touched me the most was how invested they were. I would have to force them to go eat because they were so focused on capturing everything perfectly. From late nights to early mornings, they showed up with the same energy, the same dedication, and the same big-hearted enthusiasm.

Their work ethic, their vibe, their passion — everything is admirable. My entire family is genuinely grateful that they were part of our celebration. They didn’t just capture our memories… they became a beautiful part of them.

Highly, highly recommended.

I've been going to Rachit Vora Studio for the last ten years, and I'm SO happy to say that my experience of shooting in his studio has been THE BEST so far 🤩! The way it's made, the aesthetics, the technicians, the spot boy, studio boy - the way everything
is put together is COMMENDABLE and STATE OF THE ART considering it's Mumbai city. The facilities provided for photographers, videographers, and content makers are AMAZING 😍!
